title: America's Black Forum
description: Political analyst Marc Morial hosts a weekly syndicated newsmagazine series featuring in-depth and engaging interviews with newsmakers, influencers, business entrepreneurs, artists, health and wellness experts and social justice leaders. Targeted to an African American audience, "America's Black Forum" was an hourlong production from 1977 to 2006. It has been revived as a 30-minute series after being off the air for 15 years, but has maintained the same format.
